_doc: doc 09 §2.14 / §8.3 — the teaching curriculum. One row per city level of doc 09 §2.11's ladder above the founding level, in play order. Read by `sim/progression/goal_system.gd`; every objective kind in it is a small pure evaluator in that file's EVENT_KINDS / STATE_KINDS tables, and a row naming a kind that file does not know is DROPPED at parse rather than crashing a city.
_ruling: Objectives ADVANCE the level; they do not gate it (doc 93 §G1). `city_level = max(population_ladder, objectives_earned)`, so the doc 92 §19 population rungs stay underneath as a backstop for a player who ignores the sheet — and for every scripted agent in `tools/playtest.gd`, which is why the balance matrix still measures the ladder it was fitted on.
_verbs: EVERY objective below is reachable from a surface the player can actually touch today: the build sheet (`cmd_place_building`, `cmd_place_grid_component`, `cmd_place_water_component`), its ROADS tab and the drag-path tool (`cmd_place_road` / `cmd_upgrade_road` / `cmd_demolish_road` / `cmd_place_water_main`, doc 12 §2.7), the building panel (`cmd_upgrade_building`) and its actions row (`cmd_repair_building` / `cmd_set_priority` / `cmd_demolish_building`, doc 12 §2.9 item 6), the land panel (`cmd_buy_block` / `cmd_start_development`), the dashboard's tax slider (`cmd_set_tax_level`) and the incident drawer (`cmd_dispatch_unit`). Wave 10 opened the last three doors doc 92 §17.6 recorded as missing, so `stamp_road_tiles` and `repair_buildings` are authorable and are used below. `place_water_main` is reachable but deliberately UNUSED: doc 05 §6 already runs a service lateral for every placed pump, so a main objective would teach reach the curriculum city does not yet need — see doc 93 §G4. `tests/test_goals_system.gd` holds this file to the reachable set.
_pacing: Targets are FITTED against the `curriculum` agent — a competent player who does the taught task and otherwise plays like `balanced`. One game-hour is one real minute at 1x (`SimHost.GAME_MS_PER_REAL_MS` = 60), so the measured durations ARE the session beat. RE-MEASURED for the Wave-10 re-arc (doc 92 §23.3, instrument `tools/measure_curriculum.gd`, seeds 1337/4242/9001, 21 game-days): levels are earned at game-hours 13-14 / 51-55 / 111-119 / 175-192 / 351-371, i.e. durations 13-14 / 38-41 / 60-64 / 64-73 / 159-196. Levels 1 and 2 are bit-identical to the pre-re-arc run; the two new rows land on 3 and 4. Level 3 costs 14-16 game-hours more than it did, which is the price of $7,200 of street on a treasury that is still thin, and it still arrives on game-day 4 on every seed against gate 21's ruled bound of 6. Retuning a target here is a BALANCE change: measure it with the `curriculum` agent and re-derive doc 92 §23.3 before you move it, and `tests/test_balance_gates.gd` gate 21 is what holds you to it.
